w:r.w:t: Original: Apr 22 | Revision: Full audit + Supabase schema comparison
Scope: Next.js, Supabase, cron, webhooks, admin, UI/UX

Re-audit of April 22 report. Original 38 issues: 33 fixed, 5 remain. May 2 audit found 7 new: 3 fixed, 4 remain. May 3: owner filed 10 items (3 bugs OWN-1–3, 7 features OWN-4–11). May 4: implemented 7 items (#23, OWN-2, OWN-3+8, OWN-7, OWN-10, OWN-11). 42 of 52 total resolved.
next param validated against // and protocol prefixes
Cron routes vulnerable if CRON_SECRET unset
All four routes check if (!secret) before compare
Dismiss removed; always visible until verified
KPI uses status=sent; maps from reminder_log
RPC with error handling, no silent fallback
Digest loads all events without filter
Signup form exposes raw Supabase errors
Last-year gift only checks one year back
Both webhook secrets added to env validation
Digest weak null check for digest_enabled
Sidebar links to /about inside auth layout
reauthenticate() replaces signInWithPassword(); nonce-based, no duplicate session
Contact/event save errors expose raw messages
All raw error.message replaced with friendlyError()
No user_id filter on contact/event updates
.eq(user_id, userId) added to all 7 update/delete queries
Password change error exposes raw message
CLAUDE.md says countdown badges are remaining
Contact form rate limiting is in-memory
In-memory JS Map resets on cold start. Bypassable via distributed requests.
Use Upstash Redis or Vercel KV.
Conversion events lose context on cascade
FK uses ON DELETE SET NULL. Cascades orphan analytics data.
Migration 012: delete_user_account() now UPDATEs conversion_events SET user_id/reminder_id = NULL instead of DELETE. Analytics data (partner, category, commission) survives account deletion.
Recycling bin restore doesn't clear confirm
setConfirmDeleteId(null) missing in handleRestore. Stale confirm state persists after restore.
Add setConfirmDeleteId(null) at start of handleRestore().
Email queue admin mislabels display name
userEmail variable shows display_name or UUID, not email. Admins can’t identify user.
Query email from auth.users via admin client.
Modal focus trap and ARIA missing
Modals lack role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap. Screen readers can tab outside.
Add ARIA attributes + focus trap to all modals.
No feedback when month change clamps day (e.g., Jan 31 → Feb 28). Silent clamp.
Urgency stat card color inconsistent: gray at 0, red at >0.
Use consistent color regardless of count.
Section 3: Remaining New Issues + Owner-Reported Bugs (4 + 1)
May 2 audit (NEW-3–6) + 3 owner bugs May 3 (OWN-1–3). NEW-1, NEW-2, NEW-7 fixed. OWN-1 fixed May 3. OWN-2, OWN-3 fixed May 4.
Calendar URL shows raw userId in settings UI
Settings shows raw UUID in calendar URL input. Actual subscription uses HMAC, but displayed URL leaks UUID.
Display only the signed URL from /api/calendar-url.
7-day trash hold hardcoded in two places
TRASH_HOLD_DAYS=7 hardcoded in both settings/page.tsx and purge/route.ts. Mismatch risk.
Extract to shared constant in src/lib/constants.ts.
Email in URL parameter on forgot-password link
Auth page passes email in query string (?email=...), exposed in browser history/proxy logs/referrer.
Store in session state or have user re-enter on forgot-password page.
Legacy prototype files still in repo root
7+ prototype HTML files + js/store.js in repo root. Could confuse contributors.
Move to legacy/ dir or archive branch.
Public /contact form submit fails. API route validates and sends via Resend; likely client-side issue (fetch handling or Resend config).
Debug handleSubmit in contact/page.tsx. curl /api/contact to isolate client vs server. Verify Resend domain + info@daysight.xyz. Add visible error state to UI.
Works on desktop, fails on mobile. Magic link opens in different browser context (in-app vs default); /auth/callback code exchange fails or cookies don’t carry to /auth/reset-password.

PKCE flow: forgot-password redirectTo now points directly to /auth/reset-password (skipping server callback). Reset page exchanges ?code= client-side via supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(). Desktop cookie-based flow still works as fallback. Suspense boundary added for useSearchParams.
Recycling bin only shows deleted contacts, not deleted events
Bin only queries soft-deleted contacts. Events with deleted_at IS NOT NULL not shown. Related to OWN-8.

Combined with OWN-8. Bin now has Contacts/Events sub-tabs. loadTrashedContacts() fetches both soft-deleted contacts and events in parallel. Events show event type, contact name, date, countdown badge, Restore / Delete Forever.
Live DB (riztuyrmtyuwulezivqi) vs 8 local migrations. Core tables/RPCs match. Discrepancies below.
list_migrations returns []. New environments won’t know which to skip.
Partial index on events.deleted_at IS NOT NULL in live DB, not in migrations.
Add to migration 001 or new migration 009.
Partial index events.user_id WHERE deleted_at IS NULL in live DB, not in migrations.
Add to migration 001 or create cleanup migration 009.
Live: idx on (user_id, created_at). Migration 003: idx on (user_id, sent_at). Column mismatch.
Align migration to whichever column cron actually queries.
events.deleted_at exists in live DB, no migration defines it.
Add migration to codify event soft-delete.
6 deny policies (reminder_log + shown_gifts) in live DB, not in migrations.
Supabase-managed trigger, auto-enables RLS on new tables.
All 8 core tables correct (profiles, contacts, events, reminder_log, shown_gifts, gift_catalog, conversion_events, email_overrides)
All 4 RPCs match (handle_new_user, set_updated_at, update_drips_sent, delete_user_account)
Previous Tier 1 security items (NEW-1, #11, #12, NEW-2) all fixed.
Reconcile empty Supabase migration history with CLI
reminder_log index mismatch (created_at vs sent_at) — align to actual query
OWN-2: Fix mobile password reset (FIXED May 4)
#25: Fix bin restore stale confirm state
NEW-5: Remove email from forgot-password URL param
OWN-10: Data export → admin-only API route (FIXED May 4)
Tier 3 — Address during UI conformity sweep
NEW-3: Calendar URL → signed URL only
Add deny RLS policies to migrations (reminder_log, shown_gifts)
Section 6: Owner-Requested Features & Changes (7 — 5 fixed, 2 remain)
Optional gender/pronoun field. Improves gift engine relevance and email personalization.

Migration: ADD COLUMN gender text CHECK (male/female/non-binary/other/prefer_not_to_say) DEFAULT NULL. Add dropdown to contacts/page.tsx, contacts/[id]/page.tsx, onboarding Step 2. Optionally update gift-engine.ts + email templates.
Add budget tier to onboarding flow
Onboarding Step 3 has gift categories but no budget tier. DB column + contacts page already support it.

Add a budget tier <select> to onboarding/page.tsx Step 3 (same options as contacts page: Any budget, Under $50, $50–$100, Over $100). Add budgetTier state variable and include it in the handleSaveAndFinish contacts.insert payload as budget_tier. No migration needed.
Escape key to close all modals and popups
Escape should dismiss all modals: Add/Edit Contact, Delete confirm, Add/Edit Event, Calendar Help.
Shared useEscapeKey(callback) hook. Apply in contacts/page.tsx, contacts/[id]/page.tsx, settings/page.tsx. Also add backdrop onClick to close.
Add Contact should flow directly into adding an event
Adding contact requires 2 extra clicks to add first event.
On add-mode save: .insert().select().single() to get new ID, then router.push(/contacts/${newId}?addEvent=true). Detail page checks addEvent param and auto-opens Add Event modal.
Add deleted-events tab to the recycling bin
Bin only shows deleted contacts. Need events tab with type, date, contact name, restore/delete.

Implemented in settings/page.tsx. Bin has Contacts/Events sub-tabs with pill toggles + counts. loadTrashedContacts() fetches both in parallel. TrashedEvent interface with contact_name join. handleRestoreEvent/handlePermanentDeleteEvent handlers.
Update privacy policy (outdated cookie and retention language)
Outdated cookie refs, mismatched retention timelines, vague GDPR basis (flagged in CLAUDE.md).
Rewrite privacy/page.tsx: remove cookie refs, align retention, map processing to GDPR bases. Legal review before deploy.
Move data export to admin-only; remove from user settings
Remove user-facing export. Users email support. Add admin tool: search by email, export CSV.

Removed handleExport + button from settings/page.tsx. Created /api/admin/export?userId= route with session-based is_admin check, admin client for cross-user data fetch (profile, contacts, events, reminder_log). Returns JSON with Content-Disposition attachment header.
Unsaved changes warning on Settings page
Warn on navigation with unsaved changes. Dialog: Save / Leave without saving / Cancel.

initialProfile state set on load + after save. hasUnsavedChanges derived via JSON.stringify comparison. beforeunload event fires when dirty. Tab switches intercepted via handleTabSwitch → pendingTab state → confirmation modal (Stay / Discard). “Unsaved changes” label shown next to Save button when dirty. Discard reverts to initialProfile.
OWN-6: Escape to close modals (hook + backdrop)
Re-audit: 30 fixes verified, 7 new issues, schema drift analysis
Fixed NEW-1 (user_id), #11 (password), #12+NEW-2 (errors), NEW-7 (CLAUDE.md). 5 issues moved to fixed.
Added 10 owner items (OWN-1–3 bugs, OWN-4–11 features) into Sections 3, 5, 6. Deleted BACKLOG.md.

Implemented 7 items: #23 (anonymize conversion_events), OWN-2 (PKCE mobile reset), OWN-3+8 (bin events tab), OWN-7 (add-contact flow), OWN-10 (admin export API), OWN-11 (unsaved-changes guard). Migration 012 added. Updated counts and statuses.
